# Domain Decoded

> Domain Decoded is the site of Imteaz (Galib) Chowdhury, a domain investor, naming strategist, brand builder and LinkedIn ghostwriter based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It lists trademark-cleared, comparable-sales-verified premium .COM domains and offers two services: domain naming and brokerage, and LinkedIn ghostwriting. Every domain is screened with DIOS (Domain Investing Operating System), a five-stage due-diligence process, before it is listed.

Site languages: English, Arabic (العربية), Mandarin Chinese (中文), Spanish (Español). Each page has a translated version with the suffix -ar, -zh or -es (for example services-ar.html).

## Main pages
- [Home and portfolio](https://galibimteaz.github.io/): premium .COM domains for sale with trademark, history and comparable-sales checks
- [Services and pricing](https://galibimteaz.github.io/services.html): LinkedIn ghostwriting plans and domain naming, brokerage and audit pricing, with payment details
- [About Imteaz (Galib) Chowdhury](https://galibimteaz.github.io/about.html): who runs the site, how the work is done, and how to get in touch
- [FAQ](https://galibimteaz.github.io/faq.html): answers on LinkedIn ghostwriting, domain buying, trademark clearance, UDRP history, valuation, brokerage, pricing and payment
- [DIOS due-diligence workflow](https://galibimteaz.github.io/workflow.html): the five-stage process behind every listing
- [Why it matters to founders](https://galibimteaz.github.io/why-it-matters.html)
- [Blog](https://galibimteaz.github.io/blog.html): articles on domain pricing, trademark screening, naming and new gTLDs
- [Contact](https://galibimteaz.github.io/contact.html)

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://galibimteaz.github.io/privacy-policy.html): analytics cookies load only after the visitor accepts; visitor data is not sold, shared or used for other purposes
- [Disclaimer](https://galibimteaz.github.io/disclaimer.html): what trademark screening, valuations, brokerage and ghostwriting do and do not guarantee
